ai_summary: **Executive Summary: Cosmo First Limited Q1 FY27 Earnings**  Cosmo First Limited reported robust Q1 FY27 sales growth of 46% (9% volume) and 26% absolute EBITDA growth, driven by raw material price pass-through and all B2B segments achieving profitability. The company is now focused on improving ROCE from 11% to 15-20% and aims to reduce its 2.3x Net Debt/EBITDA ratio to below 2x within 12 months, leveraging recently completed capex and strong growth in new business verticals. A notable point is that BOPP margins included a non-repetitive stock gain, while moderate PAT growth was observed due to increased depreciation and interest expenses from new capacities.
